<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

The `nightly-1-npu-a3` MMLU case never finishes on the NPU CI runners. `sgl_eval` downloads the `cais/mmlu` archive with its own `httpx` client: it ignores `HF_ENDPOINT`, prints nothing while downloading and never retries, so the run sits silent after `sgl-eval mmlu generation: ...` until the per-file timeout. The runners can only reach Hugging Face through the mirror, so the archive must be staged before the test starts.

Separately, `test_npu_hicache_mamba` left the Mamba SSM path at the model config's dtype and failed on A3.

## Modifications

- `_npu-pr-test-stage.yml`: prefetch `data.tar` with `hf download cais/mmlu --include data.tar --local-dir` (goes through `HF_ENDPOINT`, has progress and retries), then export `SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR`. A failed prefetch only emits a warning, so the job degrades to the previous behaviour.
- `npu_eval_accuracy_kit.py`: add `honor_local_sgl_eval_archive()`. It matches a prefetched archive by URL basename, re-checks the sha256 that `sgl_eval` pins (a stale mirror copy falls back to the original download), and hands `sgl_eval` a private copy because it unlinks the returned path. The shim is applied on import, so every NPU accuracy case benefits without per-test changes.
- `test_mmlu.py`: call the shim explicitly for the DeepEP MMLU cases, which do not import the kit.
- `test_npu_hicache_mamba.py`: pass `--mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16` in `common_args`.
- `nightly-test-npu.yml`: PR-triggered runs only exercise `nightly-1-npu-a3`, which hosts both cases under test; every other job stays gated on non-PR events. Scheduled and manual runs are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test_npu_sampling_backend.test_mmlu` (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 64 questions, threshold 0.65): previously stalled in `nightly-1-npu-a3`; with the archive prefetched the dataset load is local and the score is reported as before.
- `test_npu_hicache_mamba`: no accuracy expectation change; the SSM path now runs bfloat16 explicitly instead of the config default.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.

 import math
 import os

 import requests
 
@@ -32,6 +33,64 @@ class TestFoo(CustomTestCase, NPUGSM8KMixin):
     "nightly-test-npu.yml" not in os.environ.get("GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF", "")
 )
 
+# sgl_eval downloads benchmarks (MMLU data.tar included) with its own httpx
+# client: it ignores HF_ENDPOINT, prints nothing and never retries, so a blocked
+# mirror looks like a hang. CI prefetches the archive instead; the shim below
+# re-checks the pinned digest and feeds prepare the local file.
+_SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_ENV = "SGLANG_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR"
+_SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_DEFAULT = Path.home() / ".cache" / "sgl_eval" / "archives"
+
+
+def honor_local_sgl_eval_archive():
+    """Point sgl_eval's archive-backed prepare at a prefetched local copy."""
+    archive_dir = Path(
+        os.environ.get(_SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_ENV) or _SGL_EVAL_ARCHIVE_DIR_DEFAULT
+    )
+    if not archive_dir.is_dir():
+        return
+    try:
+        from sgl_eval.evals import _loader
+    except ImportError:
+        return
+    original = getattr(_loader, "_save_data_from_verified_archive", None)
+    file_sha256 = getattr(_loader, "_file_sha256", None)
+    if (
+        original is None
+        or file_sha256 is None
+        or getattr(original, "_sglang_local_archive_shim", False)
+    ):
+        return
+
+    def _save_data_from_verified_archive(
+        mod, save_args, save_kwargs, archive_url, archive_sha256, work_dir
+    ):
+        local = archive_dir / archive_url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+        expected = (archive_sha256 or "").lower()
+        if not (
+            expected
+            and hasattr(mod, "URL")
+            and local.is_file()
+            and file_sha256(local) == expected
+        ):
+            return original(
+                mod, save_args, save_kwargs, archive_url, archive_sha256, work_dir
+            )
+        # save_data() writes <work_dir>/<archive name>; the prefetched copy
+        # lives elsewhere, so urlretrieve() cannot truncate its own source.
+        original_url = mod.URL
+        try:
+            mod.URL = local.as_uri()
+            mod.save_data(*save_args, **save_kwargs)
+        finally:
+            mod.URL = original_url
+
+    _save_data_from_verified_archive._sglang_local_archive_shim = True
+    _loader._save_data_from_verified_archive = _save_data_from_verified_archive
+
+
+# Applied on import, so no per-case wiring is needed; a no-op without the dir.
+honor_local_sgl_eval_archive()
+

     """Send a single inference request for PR pipeline smoke test."""
